run_mdr_phonon_benchmark: run a phonon benchmark calculation for an MDR PBE dataset point using a Phonopy object and ASE calculator
get_phonopy_object: create a Phonopy API object from ASE Atoms or pymatgen Structure with specified supercell and displacement parameters
produce_force_constants: compute forces for displaced supercells and produce force constants using an ASE calculator and Phonopy object
calculate_phonon_frequencies: calculate phonon frequencies at supercell commensurate qpoints or a custom set of qpoints in THz
calculate_thermal_properties: calculate vibrational free energy, entropy, and heat capacity across a temperature range using Fourier interpolation
